COLOR USAGE RULES

- Use the main color for `mainIdea` / `principle`.

- Use the two detail-card pastels from the same palette to alternate card backgrounds.

- Use the contrast pastel for `consequence`, `conclusion` (preferred), `quote` or `etymology` (preferred), or any bottom accent block that closes the infographic.

- Pastels are background fills only; never use them for text or icons.

- Bright accents are used as pigments on keywords/icons or as the fill of the single `crown card`.

- All icons and body text use graphite.

- Never embed color markup inside rendered text.

- Describe pigmentation as a separate instruction above the text block.

- Rendered text must stay clean: no brackets, no hex codes, no markup characters.

- This applies to title accents, etymology highlights, and pull-quote keywords.

TYPOGRAPHIC CHARACTER

Geometric sans-serif.

TYPOGRAPHY

- Title: UPPERCASE extra-bold, 2 lines max.

- Subtitle: sentence case, gray text.

- Card title plates: UPPERCASE bold white on graphite, 10px corner radius, 8px x 16px padding, identical font size across all detail cards.

- Body text: sentence case, graphite.

- Sub-points: sentence case, bold graphite.

- Etymology: italic.

- Meta pill: UPPERCASE, light gray on dark slate, letter spacing +0.05em.
